from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np, sys

# ansa ligand: Me2Si(CH2CH2)SiMe2 bridging two tetramethyl-Cp rings
lig = Chem.MolFromSmiles("C[Si](C)(CC[Si](C)(C)c2c(C)c(C)c(C)c2C)c1c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C")
# 1-adamantanol (O on bridgehead)
adm = Chem.MolFromSmiles("OC12CC3CC(CC(C3)C1)C2")
combo = Chem.CombineMols(lig, adm)
rw = Chem.RWMol(combo)
ti_idx = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(22))
o_idx = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='O'][0]
rw.AddBond(ti_idx, o_idx, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
ring_cs = [a.GetIdx() for a in rw.GetAtoms() if a.GetIsAromatic()]
print("aromatic ring carbons:", len(ring_cs))
for c in ring_cs:
    rw.AddBond(ti_idx, c, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
Chem.SanitizeMol(rw, Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_ALL ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_PROPERTIES ^ Chem.SanitizeFlags.SANITIZE_KEKULIZE)
mol = rw.GetMol()

best = None
for seed in range(200):
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = seed
    params.useRandomCoords = True
    ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
    if ok != 0:
        continue
    conf = mol.GetConformer()
    pos = conf.GetPositions()
    ti = pos[ti_idx]
    # ring centroids
    rings = mol.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()
    arings = [r for r in rings if all(mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetIsAromatic() for i in r)]
    cents = [pos[list(r)].mean(axis=0) for r in arings]
    d_c = [np.linalg.norm(c - ti) for c in cents]
    # Ti-C distances
    d_tc = [np.linalg.norm(pos[c]-ti) for c in ring_cs]
    # check rings face Ti: angle centroid-Ti-centroid
    v1 = cents[0]-ti; v2 = cents[1]-ti
    ang = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(v1,v2)/np.linalg.norm(v1)/np.linalg.norm(v2)))
    # clash check: min nonbonded distance
    from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
    dmin = pdist(pos).min()
    score = abs(d_c[0]-2.07)+abs(d_c[1]-2.07)+abs(ang-135)/50.0
    print(f"seed {seed}: d_cent={d_c[0]:.2f},{d_c[1]:.2f} ang={ang:.1f} TiC {min(d_tc):.2f}-{max(d_tc):.2f} dmin={dmin:.2f} score={score:.3f}")
    if best is None or score < best[0]:
        best = (score, seed, pos.copy())
print("BEST seed:", best[1], "score", best[0])
np.save("best_pos.npy", best[2])
# save xyz
pos = best[2]
atoms = [a.GetSymbol() for a in mol.GetAtoms()]
with open("initial_rdkit.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write(f"{len(atoms)}\nRDKit-embedded Ti complex\n")
    for s,p in zip(atoms,pos):
        f.write(f"{s} {p[0]:.6f} {p[1]:.6f} {p[2]:.6f}\n")
print("natoms:", len(atoms))
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist

lig = Chem.MolFromSmiles("C[Si](C)(CC[Si](C)(C)c2c(C)c(C)c(C)[c-]2C)c1c(C)c(C)c(C)[c-]1C")

rw.AddBond(ti_idx, o_idx, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)

for c in ring_cs:
    rw.AddBond(ti_idx, c, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.UpdatePropertyCache(strict=False)
mol = rw.GetMol()

best = None
for seed in range(300):
    params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed = seed
    params.useRandomCoords = True
    ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
    if ok != 0:
        continue
    conf = mol.GetConformer()
    pos = conf.GetPositions()
    ti = pos[ti_idx]
    rings = mol.GetRingInfo().AtomRings()
    arings = [r for r in rings if all(mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetIsAromatic() for i in r)]
    cents = [pos[list(r)].mean(axis=0) for r in arings]
    d_c = [np.linalg.norm(c - ti) for c in cents]

    ang = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(v1,v2)/np.linalg.norm(v1)/np.linalg.norm(v2)))
    # planarity: max deviation of ring atoms from ring plane
    plan = []
